task.title: Verify Connectivity
task.shortdesc: Verify that a client device can connect to the , access the local network, and access Internet services.

prereq.p: Before you verify connectivity, make sure that:

ul.li: The or Optical Network Terminal (ONT) is connected to the ISP service.
The is connected to the or ONT.
The client device is connected through Ethernet or Wi-Fi.
The status indicators on the network devices show normal operation.

context.p: Verify the connection in stages. First, verify the connection between the client device and the . Then, verify Internet access.
context.note: An active Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection does not always indicate that Internet access is available.
If Internet access is not available, verify the assigned IP address, default gateway, and DNS server before you change the network configuration.

step.cmd: Check the network status on the client device.

choices.choice: For a wired connection, confirm that the device shows an active Ethernet connection.
For a wireless connection, confirm that the device is connected to .

step.stepresult: The client device shows an active network connection.

step.cmd: Verify that the client device can access the .

substep.cmd: Confirm that the sign-in page for the opens.

info.note: You do not have to sign in to verify local access. The sign-in page confirms that the client device can communicate with the router.

step.stepresult: The client device can communicate with the .

substep.cmd: Confirm that the website opens without a connection error.

info.note: If the router sign-in page opens but the external website does not open, the local network connection is active, but the Internet connection is not available.

step.stepresult: The client device can access Internet services.

step.cmd: Verify that the client device appears in the list of connected devices.

substep.cmd: Sign in to the by using the .
Open the list of connected devices.
Confirm that the client device appears in the list.

info.p: The client device can appear by its device name, IP address, or MAC address.

step.stepresult: The identifies the client device as a connected device.

step.cmd: Verify the network settings on the client device.

substep.cmd: Confirm that the device has a valid address.
Confirm that the assigned subnet mask is .
Confirm that the default gateway is .
Confirm that a valid DNS server address is assigned.

info.p: If the device uses automatic configuration, the assigns the network settings. The assigned IP address is typically in the .
info.note: The assigned values can differ if the network uses a custom IP address range or a custom DNS server.

step.cmd: Repeat the connectivity test on another client device.

info.p: Test at least one wired device and one wireless device if both connection types are available.

step.stepresult: The tested client devices can access the local network and Internet services.

result.p: The client devices can communicate with the and access Internet services. The home network setup is complete.

postreq.p: If a client device cannot connect to the local network, see .
If client devices can access the router but cannot access the Internet, see .
